description: Ministry of Defence  - The Prashansaneeya Seva Vibhushanaya and The Prashansaneeya Seva Padakkama
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the awarding of military service medals (Prashansaneeya Seva Vibhushanaya and Prashansaneeya Seva Padakkama) to naval personnel. This falls under public service recognition and awards, which is categorized under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with service honors and recognition within the public sector/armed forces.
